# Fast conversational core: streaming hot path + async task orchestration (Meet-first)

## Why

Johnny's voice conversation was compared against openclaw's "Start Talk" feature, which responds near-instantly. Two code-verified deep dives (openclaw + Johnny) found the gap and the operator set direction: keep the split STT→router→LLM→TTS pipeline (no cloud speech-to-speech replacement) but refactor it — the router is slow and the pipeline underperforms. Google Meet (multi-participant) is the primary surface.

## Vision

Adopt openclaw's "Start Talk" lessons inside Johnny's split pipeline:

1. **Stream everything before the LLM** — STT runs DURING speech (interim + fast final), endpointing commits early when the utterance is confidently complete, providers are prewarmed, TTS head-of-line shrinks, the client cuts bot audio locally on barge-in.
2. **Router stays but becomes fast triage** — outcome set {silent | speak | delegate | status}. Simple asks answered immediately; complex asks get an instant verbal ack ("let me check on that") and are delegated.
3. **Async task threads** (openclaw's "forced consult" pattern, Johnny-shaped) — an operational controller (task registry, status, progress queries: "are you still working on that?") and an executional layer (tool calls: Calendar first, Gmail later; webhook/callback re-entry). LangGraph evaluated as the engine for multi-step kinds (operator-requested).
4. **Speech queue with conversational re-entry** — pending utterances (ack > requested-status > unsolicited-result > notice) delivered only at turn boundaries/silence, with expiry; never cuts a participant off.

## Preserved unchanged (invariants)

- INV-1 ("exactly one terminal per turn", TurnLedger) and INV-2 — hard constraints; a delegated turn's terminal is its ack utterance; async results are session-scoped speech (approval-reply precedent), never turn terminals.
- Replay-harness verdict parity: router schema changes are additive; old model outputs parse byte-for-byte identically.
- Meet/room turn-taking semantics untouched by Phase-1 endpointing work (browser-session-scoped knobs only).
- agentsession orchestrator (no legacy engine work); S2S/unified path out of scope (Johnny-20h stays deferred).
- Docker-only runtime; clean-install reproducibility (all new deps in pyproject); chrome-devtools browser validation for every UI-visible change.

## Replaced / built

- Plain VAD endpointing on the browser session → tuned endpointing + roomless semantic turn detector (in-process InferenceExecutor shim).
- Batch-only Parakeet → cache-aware streaming `transcribe_stream`.
- Router as monolithic should-speak gate → triage with delegate/status actions + task catalog + ~8 s budget.
- Nothing → agent_tasks table, TaskCoordinator, worker executor pass, ToolRegistry (calendar.upcoming_events first), task events, speech queue, webhook entry, Gmail scope, session-page tasks panel.

## Anchors

- Latency targets (docs/LATENCY.md, speech-end → first audible byte): p50/p95 = 300/500 ms all-local, 250/450 mixed, 200/400 all-cloud. Re-measured at every phase capstone via the Phase-0 harness.
- Live-Meet E2E scenario: complex ask → ack ≤ ~2 s → conversation continues → status query answered → result delivered at a conversational boundary.

## Phases (capstone-gated)

- Phase 0 — Baseline & foundations: Johnny-cxu baseline (absorbed as child), scripted latency harness, livekit-agents 1.5.17 surface verification (say()/user_state_changed), replay parity fixtures.
- Phase 1 — Hot-path latency quick wins: endpointing knobs, roomless semantic turn detector, Piper chunk_bytes 1024, provider prewarm, client-side auto barge-in, Meet bridge audit.
- Phase 2 — Streaming STT in the voice pipeline: Parakeet cache-aware streaming, live interim captions, Deepgram verification + all-cloud numbers.
- Phase 3 — Router triage refactor: parity-safe schema extension, gate branching + ack terminal, agent_tasks + TaskCoordinator + stub executor, triage budget/observability (+ deferred speculative-parallel spike).
- Phase 4 — Async execution: LangGraph evaluation spike, ToolRegistry + calendar tool, worker executor pass, task event plumbing.
- Phase 5 — Speech queue & re-entry: pure queue core, wiring + TaskEventListener + delivery timing, real status query, live-Meet validation.
- Phase 6 — Entry points & cutover: webhook callback endpoint, Gmail scope + tool, session-page tasks panel, docs + final acceptance.

Related (not duplicated): Johnny-20h (deferred S2S epic — explicitly out of scope here), Johnny-stt (Parakeet streaming provider work references it), Johnny-ckz.7 (shipped per-turn timing instrument this epic's measurements ride on), Johnny-1ge (shipped persistent TTS).

Full approved plan: /Users/nikita/.claude/plans/project-projects-openclaw-has-a-soft-barto.md (2026-06-10).
